summary: ICICI Bank filed a 6-K announcing receipt of a show cause notice dated September 30, 2026, from Mumbai GST authorities under Section 73 of the Maharashtra GST Act, 2017, demanding INR 2,291,435,396 plus interest and penalty on services to customers maintaining specified minimum balances. The Bank is already litigating similar past assessments, including by writ petition, and will reply within prescribed timelines. Disclosure was made because the cumulative amount crosses its materiality threshold. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or transaction structure is involved; watch litigation and reserve risk from potential adverse GST outcome.
